name: @studio/audio-analysis
description: Measuring an audio FILE: decode it (the engine's `--decode` where there is one, ffmpeg otherwise), build the `{file}.cache` sidecar — peak/RMS/three-band envelope, onsets, tempo — and read its true peak. The only producer of the sidecar. Node-only, unlike @studio/audio-probe, which only MEASURES already-decoded audio. Consumed as source.
